rows.label: qst501301_msg0001
rows.name: Mo-mo... This is a problem, mo...

rows.label: qst501301_msg0002
rows.name:
What should I do with this empty
warehouse, mo...

rows.label: qst501301_msg0003
rows.name:
If I'm not going to use it, I might
as well give it to someone for free,
mo...

rows.label: qst501301_msg0004
rows.name: Mo-mo?!

rows.label: qst501301_msg0005
rows.name: You're Drivers and Blades, mo?

rows.label: qst501301_msg0006
rows.name:
I inherited this warehouse from my
Salvager father, but I don't use it
anymore, mo...

rows.label: qst501301_msg0007
rows.name: Mo!

rows.label: qst501301_msg0008
rows.name:
Don't some of the Blades with you
have rather demanding wishes, mo?

rows.label: qst501301_msg0009
rows.name:
Like wanting their own bookcase, or
somewhere to store favorite things...

rows.label: qst501301_msg0010
rows.name:
So I'll rent this empty warehouse to
you Drivers, mo! For 100,000G!

rows.label: qst501301_msg0011
rows.name:
Didn't I just hear you saying
something about "free"...?

rows.label: qst501301_msg0012
rows.name:
I could've sworn I heard
you say something about
giving it away for free.

rows.label: qst501301_msg0013
rows.name:
That is quite the bold offer. Were
you not muttering about giving it
away for free a few moments ago?

rows.label: qst501301_msg0014
rows.name:
You greedy little fluffball.
I heard you saying you'd give
it away for free just now!

rows.label: qst501301_msg0015
rows.name:
That's Nopon for you, mo. Even one
from Shimonia is a cheapskate, mo...

rows.label: qst501301_msg0016
rows.name:
W-well, if you can get in without
using this door, you can freely use
the warehouse, mo.

rows.label: qst501301_msg0017
rows.name:
But pay 100,000G and I'll open the
door and give you the right to use it
freely, mo.

rows.label: qst501301_msg0028
rows.name: Pay

rows.label: qst501301_msg0029
rows.name: Don't pay

rows.label: qst501301_msg0019
rows.name: Thank you for your business, mo!

rows.label: qst501301_msg0020
rows.name:
The warehouse and my father will be
happier if someone uses it instead of
leaving it empty, mo!

rows.label: qst501301_msg0021
rows.name:
And Rentarenta is thrilled to have
100,000G too, mo!

rows.label: qst501301_msg0022
rows.name:
I'll leave the door open, so you can
use it freely from now on, mo!

rows.label: qst501301_msg0023
rows.name: I'll leave the rest to you, mo!

rows.label: qst501301_msg0024
rows.name: Huh? Too expensive, mo?

rows.label: qst501301_msg0025
rows.name: Then I'll knock a little off, mo.

rows.label: qst501301_msg0026
rows.name: I can't lower it any further, mo...

rows.label: qst501301_msg0027
rows.name:
If you change your mind, come talk
to me again, mo.
